newsitem.title: USA: State Street trading tied to S&P Index entry.
newsitem.headline: State Street trading tied to S&P Index entry.

text.p: A jump in the stock of State Street Corp Thursday was probably due to anticipation that the Boston-based company will soon be included in the Standard & Poor's 500 stock index, a Wall Street source said.
Trading apparently was influenced by news that the Federal Communications Commission approved the merger of Bell Atlantic corp and Nynex Corp .
S&P had previously announced that when the merger is completed Nynex will no longer exist as an entity and State Street will take its place in the index.
When a stock joins the S&P 500 roster, managers of mutual funds which track the index have to buy the shares.
State Street, which at one point was halted for a trading imbalance, rose 3-3/16 to 55-1/2.
